findings.claim: No test exercises the value `_batch` passes as `url` to `_batch_runner` after this diff's change from a fresh `real_remote(repo)` call to `pinned.url`. Every test that reaches this line either mocks `run_batch` (so the built `runner` closure, which is the only thing that reads `url` via `_resolve_stacked_on`, is never invoked) or mocks `_batch_runner` itself. Swapping `url=pinned.url` for the type-correct but wrong `url=str(pinned.mirror)` would still pass scope/lint/types (str is still a str) and every test in this diff, including the mirror-derivation-count witness, because that witness only counts calls to `ensure_mirror`/`real_remote`/`fetch_default_branch`, not the value threaded into `_batch_runner`.
